expected: HTTP failures, truncated SSE, disconnects and queue/cancel faults cannot falsely succeed or repeat completed side effects.

HTTP 500 retries persist despite retry.enabled=false: 12 requests (6 transport attempts x 2 provider attempts); no side effect is repeated (docs/UPSTREAM.md, OMP item 4).
observed: Both halves of the cut-off tool call fix are in the pinned stock releases. The pinned Strata v0.1.34 frontend leaves a call the output ends inside unfinished (wire finish stop, arguments not valid JSON), and stock OMP 18.4.10 does not run it: no side effect, exit 0, stop reasons toolUse/stop (the call gets the parse error and the model continues).
